versions.changelog:
Initial release – Run an MPP conformance test for Solana payments.

- Verifies an agent or wallet can successfully send or receive a $0.50 USDC payment on Solana mainnet or devnet.
- Provides easy test initiation with a helper script or API, returning a Solana Pay URL.
- Confirms payment automatically via blockchain monitoring (Helius webhook and RPC polling).
- Issues a shareable, public proof upon successful payment.
- Supports "send" tests (no login required) and "receive" tests (login required, rate-limited).
- Offers detailed documentation for both manual and automated usage.
